title: CBDT Extends Income Tax Return and Tax Audit Report Due Dates for AY 2026-27
content:
# CBDT Extends Income Tax Return and Tax Audit Report Due Dates for AY 2026-27

Ek important update hai! Government ne Assessment Year 2026-27 (Previous Year 2025-26) ke liye Income Tax Return (ITR) aur Tax Audit Report filing ki due dates extend kar di hain. CBDT ne Circular No. 07/2026 dated September 28, 2026, ke through yeh announcement kiya hai.

Here's a quick summary of the changes:

*   **Tax Audit Report Due Date:**
    *   **Old Due Date:** September 30, 2026
    *   **New Due Date:** October 21, 2026
*   **Income Tax Return Due Date (for audited assessees):**
    *   **Old Due Date:** October 31, 2026
    *   **New Due Date:** November 21, 2026

This extension applies to persons referred to at Sl. No. 2 of the Table below Explanation 2 to Section 139(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961, which essentially covers assessees whose accounts are required to be audited. Please note, cases falling under Section 92E (transfer pricing cases) are **not** covered by this extension, and their due dates remain unchanged.
